rules.statement: If the transaction is a mortgage, the right of the debtor to redeem cannot be taken away even by express stipulation. On the other hand, if it is a contract of sale subject to the condition that the vendor shall be entitled to receive back the land on paying the price within the stipulated time, failure to pay disentitles the vendor to re-conveyance.
rules.supporting_quote: 'It is settled law that if the transaction in question is in fact a mortgage, the right of the debtor to redeem cannot be taken away even by express stipulation. On the other hand if it is a contract of sale subject to the condition that the vendor shall be entitled to receive back the land on paying the price, within the stipulated time in a case where a time is stipulated, the failure to pay the price within the time disentitles the vendor to a re-conveyance.'
